name: azure-virtual-desktop-enterprise
description: Enterprise Azure Virtual Desktop baseline with pooled host pool, FSLogix profile storage, landing network, Key Vault and NSG baseline, and centralized monitoring.
what: A starter AVD landing zone that provisions the core building blocks for pooled desktops in Azure: a host pool with application group and workspace, an optional scaling plan, FSLogix profile storage on Azure Files, a landing virtual network with session-host and private-endpoint subnets, baseline security controls, and centralized monitoring in Azure Monitor.
why: Organizations standardizing remote and hybrid work need a governed, repeatable way to stand up AVD with profile persistence, secure networking, and observability from day one. Composing the host pool, FSLogix storage, landing network, secret management, and diagnostics into one template accelerates rollout while preserving operational consistency across environments.
potentialUseCases: Pooled desktops for knowledge workers and contractors
Secure access to corporate apps for unmanaged or BYO devices
Seasonal or burst capacity for call centers and task workers
Standardized desktop estate during mergers, acquisitions, or datacenter exits

reliability: Pooled host pool with breadth-first load balancing across session hosts
FSLogix profile containers on Azure Files for stateless, roaming user profiles
Environment-specific parameterization for controlled dev/prod rollout
security: RBAC-enabled Key Vault baseline for secret management
Network segmentation with dedicated session-host and private-endpoint subnets plus NSG
Storage hardened with TLS 1.2, HTTPS-only, and no public blob access
costOptimization: Optional scaling plan ramps session hosts down off-peak to cut compute spend
Start-VM-on-connect avoids running idle session hosts
Use the dev profile for early validation before production scale
operationalExcellence: Infrastructure as Code modules for repeatable deployment
Unified logging via Log Analytics and Application Insights
dev/prod parameter files for promotion across environments
performanceEfficiency: Tunable max session limit per host to balance density and experience
Breadth-first load balancing spreads users for consistent performance
TransactionOptimized Azure Files tier for responsive profile I/O

components.name: Session host VMs (D4s v5) x5
components.notes: Example assumes 5 session hosts x 730 hours. A scaling plan reduces this materially; replace with your host count and schedule.
